Controls

  • Left drag a node to move it.
  • Drag from any port to a matching port to wire nodes (ESC cancels).
  • Delete a node: select it and press Delete, or right-click it → Delete node (its wires go too).
  • Break a wire: click it and press Delete, or right-click it → Delete connection.
  • Right-click the canvas to add nodes.
  • Right-click → Auto layout arranges nodes left-to-right by data flow.
  • Middle-drag or hold Space and drag to pan.
  • Scroll to zoom in/out.
  • ] toggles the Inspector panel, \ toggles the Output panel.
